plan.rationale: Source dive at the installed graphifyy 0.9.73 (python/.venv/.../graphify). Prior claim CONFIRMED for the keyless/AST path. extractors/markdown.py extract_markdown emits only a page node (node_kind page, carrying parsed YAML frontmatter under the 'frontmatter' key) and heading nodes, plus contains/references edges from inline links, ref-defs and wikilinks (including wikilinks inside frontmatter) and inline-code-span mentions resolved to code symbols; prose bodies produce no nodes, and fenced blocks are skipped. serve.py _score_query scores only norm_label, label_tokens, source_file, node 'rationale', node 'attributes' (tier #3625), node id; there is NO reference to 'frontmatter' in serve.py, export.py query paths, build.py, analyze.py, cli.py or llm.py search logic, so frontmatter description: is not searched (it is stored but unscored, and the page node label is just the filename). Bodies are indexed ONLY indirectly: the LLM semantic-extraction path (doc files in detect.DOC_EXTENSIONS: .md .mdx .qmd .txt .rst .html .yaml) produces concept nodes and a 'rationale' string that the rationale tier (#2293) matches for why-questions, so prose recall depends on running semantic extraction, not on the AST mode. Caveat: my claim that semantic mode is what indexes prose is from reading the scorer and the cli semantic-cache code, not from running an LLM extraction (no API key run, unverified live). Real GitHub examples found by fanout (manifests, items not individually fetched or verified beyond titles): issue #613 Graphify-Labs/graphify 'Connector for Noema cortex traces, skip LLM extraction, use frontmatter as ground truth' (a feature request, which itself implies frontmatter is not used as truth today); repos albertludi/second-brain-claude, silveimar/graphify, ATLAS-DEV78423/Graphify-Updated-Obsidian, Brucesquared2/claude-code-memory-setup, plus blogs charlieautomates.com and stork.ai on Graphify+Obsidian+Claude; none read in depth. context7 errored (exited 1), a named gap. github-discussions and github-releases returned empty_verified for the mandatory dependency stage. Code-search probe: query counts 21 and 2 beside must-hit 409 and 2 and known-absent 0, so the probe discriminates; the frontmatter hits were not re-fetched individually. Not run: no live graphify query against a markdown corpus control arm was executed, so the 'frontmatter not searched' conclusion rests on source reading only (an arm to run: build a graph over two .md files, one with a unique frontmatter description token and one with a unique body token, query both, and expect 0 hits for each in keyless mode).
